crossRefs.note: My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Why are you so far from helping me, and from the words of my groaning?
Don’t be far from me, for trouble is near. For there is no one to help.
But don’t be far off, Yahweh. You are my help. Hurry to help me!
For he has not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted, Neither has he hidden his face from him; but when…
Yes, they opened their mouth wide against me. They said, “Aha! Aha! Our eye has seen it!”
You have seen it, Yahweh. Don’t keep silent. Lord, don’t be far from me.

translations.web: Don’t forsake me, Yahweh. My God, don’t be far from me.
translations.bsb: Do not forsake me, O LORD; be not far from me, O my God.
translations.kjv: Forsake me not, O LORD: O my God, be not far
translations.asv: Forsake me not, O Jehovah: O my God, be not far from me.
